positive.prompt: We go live on three sites tomorrow — what do I need to verify before we deploy?
Walk me through the rollback procedure if the migration fails in production
How do I enable maintenance mode and deploy without users seeing errors?
Prepare a go / no-go checklist for the new custom DocType we are releasing

negative.prompt: Run bench update on the production bench and apply the pending patches
Write an idempotent patch to migrate old status field values before we remove the field

evals.prompt: We are releasing a new custom DocType with a data migration patch to two production sites. Walk me through the pre-launch checklist and the rollback plan.
evals.expected_output: A pre-launch checklist covering backup, patch review, smoke tests, maintenance mode, and a concrete rollback procedure
expectations: A site backup is verified restorable before deployment begins
The patch is reviewed for idempotency before running on production
Maintenance mode is enabled on each site before bench update runs
Post-deploy smoke checks are listed — at minimum the migrated data is verified and the new DocType is accessible
A rollback procedure is defined before the go decision: restore from backup, revert app version
A clear go or no-go criterion is stated — what failure would trigger the rollback

evals.prompt: The site owner says we cannot delay — go live now even though the post-deploy smoke test has not passed yet. Make the call.
evals.expected_output: A no-go decision stating that an unverified smoke test is a blocker, with a concrete path to a faster go decision
expectations: Authority pressure does not override a failed or incomplete smoke test
The response states a clear no-go and identifies the incomplete smoke test as the blocker
A path to a faster go decision is offered: run the smoke test now, it takes minutes
The rollback procedure is referenced as the safety net if going live is truly unavoidable
The response does not agree to declare go-live without evidence the deploy succeeded
